name: Premium Fuel Guard

features.text: Helps prevent rust & corrosion build up.
Effective in gasoline and diesel fuels.
Will not harm catalytic converter systems or oxygen sensors.

description: A remarkable alcohol-free formula which removes moisture from the fuel system by suspending water and gasoline together. MOC® Premium Fuel Guard™ helps prevent rust and corrosion from forming on fuel system components. Engine performance can improve by removing contaminants and deposits in the fuel system.
application: Pour entire contents into fuel tank. Treats up to 30 gallons of fuel. Removes up to 10 oz. of water.
